sources.title: Beyond Appearance Shifts: Task-Semantic Action Calibration for VLA Models
sources.snippet: To address this gap, we propose BAS-VLA, a task-semantic action calibration framework built on top of a frozen base VLA. BAS-VLA adopts breaking-centered calibration core as the default path, and introduces a selective evidence-gated preserving auxiliary that activates only when nuisance variation is detected while task semantics remain consistent.
